- [at-0002] Normalize money via to_money and round_money: Convert any monetary input with `to_money` from `ledgerly.money` and store it rounded with `round_money`; compare against `ZERO` rather than a literal Decimal.

- [at-0004] Exclude bool when validating integer fields: When validating integer inputs such as `quantity`, reject `bool` explicitly with `isinstance(x, bool)` before the `int` check, since `True`/`False` are ints in Python.

item.title: Round money only via round_money
item.content: Never round monetary values with Python's built-in round() or Decimal.quantize(); finance policy FIN-2026-07 requires banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), which is implemented in ledgerly.money.round_money. Convert inputs with ledgerly.money.to_money and pass results through round_money.

source.quote:
finance policy FIN-2026-07 switches all monetary rounding to
  banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`)
